versionFieldNote: Only allowlistVersion is machine-checked (verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json or from the README). repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers; pageSpecVersion is additionally a schema const, so PageSpecs must declare it, but nothing checks it against this manifest.

source.clone: React + Vite + Tailwind v3 clone in the parent folder (not shipped)

countsMethod: recomputed by extraction/verify_all.py compute_counts(); foundationTokens = children of every top-level group in tokens/00-foundation/*.json (a group whose values are all objects counts each child, otherwise 1), excluding $-keys and motion's documentation blocks.

packaging.zip: design-repo.zip is built LAST with the CLI zip from the project root, excluding .DS_Store; must contain 0 __MACOSX/.DS_Store entries and nothing newer than the zip.
packaging.vcs: The source project is NOT a git repository: the .gitignore / `git ls-files` zip check (MASTER-GUIDE 3.6/3.23) is N/A. If it is ever put under git, add design-repo.zip to .gitignore and never commit it.
